steps.comment: OPTIONAL: mTLS on the Entra SSO Gateway - client certificate mandatory, certificate check as factor 1
steps.note: netscaler-nitro >= v1.2.0, after 10 + 11 and after the client CA certkeys (12-entra-sso-mtls-certs.json with Deploy-NsCertificates.ps1). The client CA itself (issuing, enrollment, CRL) is not part of this repo. Verified for HTML5 and hybrid launches; native Workspace app cannot add an account on a Gateway that requires a client certificate. StoreFront cannot present a client certificate: use a separate callback vserver (netscaler-nitro examples/06-callback.json) as config storeFront.callbackUrl.

steps.comment: Client CA chain on the Gateway (only these CAs are accepted)
steps.note: With a CRL of the issuing CA on the NetScaler add "crlcheck": "Mandatory" to the issuing CA binding (add ssl crl needs the CRL file first - not part of this file).

steps.comment: SSL profile: ssl_prof_entrasso_fe + client certificate mandatory, only the bound CA chain
Factor 1: certificate check that takes the UPN from the certificate -> next factor lbl_entrasso (Entra OIDC)
steps.note: Changes rule and action of auth_pol_entrasso_factor1 from 10-entra-sso-aaa.json. With a user name from factor 1 the OAuth action sends login_hint=<UPN> on the redirect to Entra by itself: the Entra page is pre-filled. No rewrite needed - a RESPONSE rewrite never sees the AAA redirect to Entra. The OAuth factor (usernamefield oid) then replaces the UPN, so StoreFront still gets the oid (lab 2026-11-02, NetScaler 14.1-73.46, hybrid launch OK). Side effect: a certificate without a UPN otherName SAN fails factor 1. login_hint only pre-fills - the user can change it, the certificate and the Entra user are still not compared. For no login_hint keep action NO_AUTHN (leave out the certAction and the action field).

steps.comment: Way back (the two PUT steps above are [MANUAL] for undo) - run BEFORE Undo-NsObjects.ps1 of this file
steps.note: set authentication policy auth_pol_entrasso_factor1 -rule true -action NO_AUTHN ; set ssl vserver gw_example_entrasso -sslProfile ssl_prof_entrasso_fe ; then Undo-NsObjects.ps1 -Journal <journal of this file> removes cert_act_entrasso_upn, the CA bindings and ssl_prof_entrasso_fe_mtls.
